uncited: - **Vertex Shader:** Computes ray direction vectors and passes them as additional texture coordinates to the fragment shader.
**Compositing:** Nodes send their rendered images to a compositing node (or the viewer).
- **Compression:** The image may be compressed using LZO real-time compression before transmission over the "last mile" (cluster to viewer).
- **Time Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of voxels and sampling points, distributed across $N$ nodes.
- **Memory Complexity:** Each node stores only its assigned bricks.
It addresses the limitations of single-GPU raycasting by leveraging cluster computing.
